headline: Musk Ventures Lose $456 Billion Market Cap Following US Midterms
summary: Public and private valuation metrics associated with Elon Musk's ventures, including Tesla, shrank by an estimated $456 billion amid broader technology stock declines and expectations of heightened regulatory scrutiny.
why: Tesla and related corporate entities hold massive weights in global equity benchmarks and retail portfolios.

impacts.name: Tesla, Inc.
impacts.why: Concerns over Democratic legislative scrutiny of tech and EV subsidies drove heavy equity selling.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A tech-wide sell-off and fears over regulatory changes following the US midterms battered Musk-linked equity valuations.
